scientific_scope: Experiment design, spatial randomisation, protocol-driven observation, maize flowering synchrony, GxExM analysis and climate-space cluster exploration.

methods.name: Factorial blocked experiment allocation
methods.status: existing method preserved and provenance strengthened
methods.implementation: Treatment combinations are assigned within declared blocks/replicates; seed and full allocation manifest are persisted in design_versions.
methods.limitations: Automatic allocation should not be treated as a universal split-plot/strip-plot/incomplete-block generator.

methods.name: Spatial adjacency-constrained randomisation heuristic
methods.implementation: Multiple seeded candidate permutations are compared within the established block structure; where Shapely geometry is available the candidate with fewer shared borders between identical treatments is retained.
methods.limitations: This reduces one form of spatial clustering but does not prove optimality or eliminate spatial confounding.

methods.name: Approximate two-group power planning
methods.implementation: Normal-approximation sample size using alpha, desired power, standardised effect size and optional design-effect multiplier.
methods.limitations: Not a replacement for design-specific mixed-model/split-plot/longitudinal power simulation.

methods.name: Block-aware mixed model
methods.implementation: statsmodels MixedLM with treatment fixed effect and block random intercept when sufficient data are present.
methods.limitations: Researchers must confirm the model matches the actual randomisation and error strata.

methods.name: Mechanistic maize parent synchrony
methods.status: existing method unchanged; integrated as advanced experiment pathway
methods.implementation: Uses the established Laurent-derived mechanistic maize engine and local observations/calibration workflows.
methods.limitations: Timing predictions do not guarantee pollen quantity, fertilisation, seed purity or yield; publication priors are not local measurements.

methods.name: Agroclimatic K-means plus PCA
methods.implementation: K-means uses the full standardised variable-by-month climate feature matrix; PCA provides a two-dimensional representation. Feasible k is bounded by min(20, n_samples-1, distinct climate profiles).
methods.limitations: Clusters are exploratory environmental groupings and are not official agroecological zones. PCA/UMAP/t-SNE plot distances should not be overinterpreted.

validation_principles: Prefer grouped, cross-season, cross-site or parent-aware validation over leakage-prone random row splits.
Distinguish measured outcomes, derived exposures, mechanistic predictions and model estimates.
Flag missing/inconsistent field data; do not silently delete or invent measurements.
